about.title: About Us
about.paragraph1: PawShop started as a small idea between two cat lovers who couldn't find food their own fussy cats actually enjoyed. Today we bring carefully chosen food, treats and accessories to cat owners across the European Union — no gimmicks, just good products and honest service.
about.paragraph2: Every order is reviewed personally, and we reach out to confirm payment and delivery before anything ships — so you're always talking to a real person, not a checkout robot.

vetApproved.description: Recipes developed with veterinary guidance for balanced, complete nutrition.

personalService.description: No online payment — we contact you personally to confirm your order.
